# Contributing to Claude Code Academy

This organization does **not** accept external pull requests at this time. The maintainer is the sole code committer for every CCA repo.

## How to contribute

### 1. Found a bug?

Open an issue using the **bug report** template:

- Visit the relevant repo (e.g. `genie-aios`, `genie-skills-library`, `genie-mobile-os`).
- Click **Issues** → **New issue** → **Bug report**.
- Fill in the form. The structured fields make triage fast.

If you have Genie installed, you can also file from inside Claude Code by saying *"report a bug"* — the `report-issue` skill drives the intake and routes the issue to the right CCA repo automatically.

### 2. Have a feature request?

Open an issue using the **feature request** template. Same path as above; pick **Feature request** instead.

### 3. Want to discuss?

Questions, ideas, and "how do I…" go to the community channel:

- Community: https://www.skool.com/claude-code-academy

Please don't open issues for general questions — keep the issue tracker focused on bugs and feature requests so the maintainer can triage efficiently.

## Why no PRs?

Practical reasons. The maintainer reviews and approves every code change personally to keep the codebase coherent and the developer-experience consistent. Accepting external PRs at this stage would slow that review cycle without a meaningful improvement in throughput.

The same policy applies across **every** repo in the Claude-Code-Academy org. No exceptions.

If you'd genuinely like to collaborate on something larger, reach out via the community channel — there may be a path that doesn't go through PRs.
